notes_for_editor: Thin record. Readable sources were the Forest Lookouts Karnack page (header only, no history), the FFLA Texas list (status and coordinates) and an undated Texas travel page (general context). Not reached: Texas Forest Service pages and NHLR or FFLOS pages for this site. A library catalog page describes the book Fire in the Piney Woods (Texas lookout towers, the forest service, and the Civilian Conservation Corps) as a lead, but its text was not read; the Duke University Press abstract returned HTTP 403. The FFLA list shows two Karnack entries: Loc 1 gone, Loc 2 standing. The sources do not say whether these are two towers or two sites for one tower. The record's 95 m elevation comes from OpenStreetMap; it was not verified here and is not in the story. Access is unknown and no access fact was added. Fact check 2026-10-09: the travel page says the towers came before airplanes but ties the word long to the earlier tree-climbing sentence, so the story drops long from the tower claim.
